3259.headline: RECOVER
3259.caption: A Sellbot HQ Memo

"Attn Sellbots:"
"I'll be in my office at the top of Sellbot Towers promoting Cogs to higher levels."
"When you earn enough merits enter the elevator in the lobby to see me."
"Break time's over - back to work!"
"Signed, Sellbot V.P."
Aha.... Flippy will want to see this. I'll send it to him right now.
Please go get your second memo and bring it back.
busy: Come back when you are finished with your ToonTask.

3260.headline: RECOVER

"Toons caught in Sellbot Towers will be detained for questioning."
"Please meet in the lobby for appetizers to discuss."
"Signed, Mingler"

Please bring a third memo back.

I put the "squash" in squash and stretch, if you know what I mean.
Listen, Sellbots have finished an enormous factory to pump out Sellbots 24 hours a day.
Get a group of Toon buddies together and squash the factory!
Inside Sellbot HQ, look for the tunnel to the Factory then board the Factory elevator.
Make sure you have full gags, full Laff points, and some strong Toons as guides.
Defeat the Foreman inside the factory to slow the Sellbot progress.
Sounds like a real workout, if you know what I mean.
busy: Come back when you are finished with your ToonTask.
after: Nice work! Here is your reward...
